answer_1.quote: We introduce a new summarization task ... Given a document, automatically generate questions and summaries that are organized hierarchically to lay out details for topics at different levels.
answer_1.outputs: hierarchically organized question-summary pairs and full-form summaries

answer_2.quote: We use ROUGE for summarization evaluation and additionally report BLEU up to 4-gram for evaluating the generated questions. We propose to evaluate the generated QS hierarchy ... with weighted precision/recall/F1 scores.

answer_4.quote: Human evaluation is conducted on QSGen-Hier, for five models ... we hire three judges who have extensive experience in summarization annotation and evaluation tasks ... First, we ask evaluators to correct each generated hierarchy ... Second, for each QS pair, we ask them to determine if the question can be answered by the summary.
answer_4.guideline: Evaluators rearrange hierarchies to minimize edits and judge whether each question is answerable by its summary.
